sample: same fixed24; no outcome, stratum, holding or menu selection changes
transport: hu20-profile-f64-v1; promoted f64 arrays, all nodes, strategies, values, masks and weights retained; serde_json arbitrary_precision disabled
ancestor_rule: Skip a cold ancestor only when its next observed action is absent from the full native menu. Keep existing candidates and uncertified on-menu ancestors to preserve rare reusable policies.
parity_before_cost: All24: identical final scientific requests, ranges/menu/locks; identical normalized finite strategy and EV bits and unavailable masks at every public node; identical raw profile values/weights; identical played completion/support, same-seed action and fresh replay without native work.
cost: One fresh policy per fixed spot, sequential, all complete decision preparation/evidence/output measured; no partial profile or cheap fallback can qualify.
concurrency_if_sequential_passes: Consider 2 then at most3 workers on the same24 spots, before strength, with aggregate simultaneous family RSS and host available memory. Admit only from measured capacity; retain all setup/contention cost. No reduction of per-search work.
strength: No strength hands or roots. Propose counts, power assumptions, replay costs and elapsed M4 budget to owner before any strength hands, even below24h.
research_failures: Retain any parity/cost failure. Fix only identified plumbing with append-preserving attempts; no strategy changes or outcome-based retuning.
concurrency_memory_admission: Two workers: projected RSS twice sequential peak, historical and fresh host availability minus2GB must both leave3GB. Three:1.5 times two-worker peak RSS, host availability minus observed incremental host-use plus0.5GB reserve must leave3GB, checked again fresh. Family capacity min(13GiB,16GiB-3GB). All runs retain aggregate sampled memory and unchanged usual guards.
concurrency_stop: Any parity/error sets shared stop, aborts barrier and cancels siblings via public preparation/native resource checks; no further spot starts. Admission binds plan/binary hashes of all source receipts.
